ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels are localized primarily at the distal margins, with low-intensity (black) pixels occupying approximately 85% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: White pigment patches are anchored at the distal tips. The left lobe exhibits a feathered, mottled boundary between white and black pixels along the trailing edge. The right lobe shows a thinner, more defined white band at the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex; angular divergence measured at approximately 30-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile; high-density peaks and valleys along the entire posterior boundary, isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a consistent convex sweep from the midline to the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Abundant circular high-contrast ring-like features scattered across the dark regions, specifically in the medial and distal zones of both lobes, corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Isolated, thin, high-intensity linear features (rake marks) observed primarily on the lower-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, protruding calcified clusters (live barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent dark island of pigment within the white distal patch of the left lobe tip.
